interface.name: deck_screen_edge_manager_v1
interface.description: Associates an auto-hide reveal action with a screen edge for a layer surface. This is a Deck desktop-shell implementation detail; regular clients must not use it.

entry.name: invalid_border
entry.summary: the specified border value is invalid

entry.name: already_constructed
entry.summary: the surface already has a screen edge

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the manager. Does not destroy objects created with it.

enum.name: border
enum.description: Top and bottom edges are supported. A top reveal is triggered by a downward vertical gesture; a bottom reveal by an upward vertical gesture. Left/right edges are omitted because horizontal gestures conflict with scene navigation, which can begin anywhere, including at a screen edge.

request.name: get_auto_hide_screen_edge
request.description:
Create an auto-hide screen edge for the layer surface. Placement stays owned by the layer surface; this only associates the reveal trigger.
invalid_border is raised for an out-of-range border; invalid_role is raised unless the surface has the layer_surface role; already_constructed is raised if the surface already has an auto-hide screen edge.

interface.name: deck_auto_hide_screen_edge_v1
interface.description: Hides a layer surface and reveals it on the edge gesture. Unlike upstream, the surface is hidden by default and holds no buffer while hidden.

description.summary: destroy the auto hide screen edge object

request.name: deactivate
request.description: Disarm the edge and request the surface be shown. The compositor emits revealed.

request.name: activate
request.description: Arm the edge and request the surface be hidden. The compositor emits hidden; the client must commit a NULL buffer and free its buffers. A spent edge (already triggered) must be re-armed with this request.

event.name: revealed

description.summary: the edge was triggered; show the surface

event.description: The edge gesture fired (or deactivate was called). The client should allocate, render, and attach a buffer. The arming is now spent.

event.name: hidden
event.description: The surface should be hidden. The client should attach a NULL buffer and free its DMA-BUFs.
